landmarks.name: Tokyo Tower
landmarks.fact: Completed in 1958, Tokyo Tower is a communications tower inspired by the Eiffel Tower in Paris.

landmarks.name: Zojoji Temple
landmarks.fact: Zojoji is a major Buddhist temple serving as the main family temple of the Tokugawa shogunate.

landmarks.name: Tokyo Station
landmarks.fact: Opened in 1914, Tokyo Station features an iconic restored red-brick facade on its Marunouchi side.

landmarks.name: Sumida River
landmarks.fact: The Sumida River flows through Tokyo and is famous for its scenic riverside walkways and cherry blossoms.

landmarks.name: Asahi Beer Hall
landmarks.fact: Designed by Philippe Starck, this building features an iconic golden flame sculpture on its rooftop.

landmarks.name: Tokyo Skytree
landmarks.fact: Standing at 634 meters, Tokyo Skytree is the tallest structure in Japan and a primary television broadcast tower.
